data.body: Gerrit 1209 gate status: LLM-Review +1 (PASS, 1 advisory non-blocking finding). The first Verified -1 was NOT a test failure - the CI run was CANCELLED because patch set 2 (a commit-message-only amend to fix a >50-char subject) superseded patch set 1 mid-run, and the -1 was then copied forward by the label copy condition. Posted 'recheck'; a fresh 'Gerrit Verified Gate' run (GHA 30757564131) is in flight. Local evidence meanwhile: tests/unit + tests/integration = 6731 passed, 21 skipped, 6 errors - and all 6 errors are the repo-HEAD-moved / REPO_ROOT-leak guards tripping on MY OWN concurrent git activity (commit, reset, push) during the 21-minute run, not code regressions; the reconciler suite run in isolation was 1808 passed.
